properties.description:
`crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_choice_is_not_a_musing.rs`, five cases against the `contradiction` finding — the one that skips only when BOTH ends are parked, so it is what shows whether a node counts as parked.

⭐ FOUR OF THE FIVE ARE COUNTERWEIGHTS, and they carry the weight: an unlabelled `proposed` Decision still parks by status (the fallback, so no design needs reclassifying); two exploratory ideas still go quiet; an ACCEPTED decision is never parked whatever kind it wears (kind must sharpen status, never override it); and one parked side against settled design STILL REPORTS.

🛑 THAT LAST ONE IS PINNED DELIBERATELY AS A GUARD AGAINST THIS VERY CHANGE. It is the assertion ophyd-service asked to have reversed, and it belongs to a decision accepted on Anthony's word 2026-08-26 which `proj:bhome` independently called correct. Pinning it here means the reversal cannot arrive as a side effect of sharpening the predicate — it would need his word and a separate change.
properties.findings:
5 passed, 0 failed, in the full workspace run of 1941 tests (0 failed) on 2026-09-01.

⭐ OBSERVED FAILING IN THE RIGHT SPLIT: 4 passed and 1 failed against the unfixed code. Only the sharpening failed; every invariant passed BEFORE the change, which is what shows these constrain the change rather than describe it.

⚠️ AND THE CHANGE IS INERT ON THIS DESIGN, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: zero of reflow2's own 225 proposed Decisions carry `kind: choice` (205 unset, 20 exploratory), so the sweep count did not move. The fixture proves the behaviour; the graph proves nobody here is affected yet. Both are true and the second is the one a reader would otherwise assume away.
properties.name: An unsettled choice is not parked, and the four things that must not move do not move
